messages:
jon: Heads-up — rolling prefetch-coalesce v0.4 to canary (eng-runtime). Quick win for bursty chat patterns.
maya: drop the numbers please.
jon: quick harness (burst-chat, seq=48):
```
Benchmark: burst-chat (seq=48)
Baseline     p50=15.4ms  p95=62.7ms  cost=0.154 units
PrefetchCo v0.4 p50=10.9ms  p95=58.9ms  cost=0.128 units  (-16.9% cost)
```
sarah: Nice cost improvement. Any change in backend token churn?
jon: backend tokens down ~9% for burst profile, effective prefix-hit +3.9pp. Host CPU +2.3%, memory flat. No cold-start issues seen.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for prefetch-coalesce v0.4 (3% eu-west) :rocket:
ops-bot: Ops note — watching coalescer/burst panels, added dash link to #oncall: https://console.redwood/perf/prefetch-coalesce-v04
jon: rollout plan: 3% -> 25% at T+90m -> 70% at T+8h -> 100% at T+36h if clean. Gate: p99 >6% regression or error-rate >0.5% -> rollback.
perf-bot: quick smoke checks running — no regressions in first 15m. :white_check_mark:
sarah: Can we tag per-tenant metrics for 24h? finance/product want the delta.
finance-bot: @sarah noted. Finance will expect a per-tenant cost-delta table within 1h of 25% checkpoint.
jon: Config toggles we flipped on canary:```yaml
enable_prefetch_coalesce: true
coalesce_window_ms: 7
prefetch_threshold: 0.28
batch_hint: 12
```
maya: Runtime-only change? any driver/kernel work?
jon: runtime-only. lightweight prefetch heuristic + tightened coalesce window. No CUDA/driver changes.
jon: If gates hold, i'll draft a 1-paragraph exec note after 25% checkpoint with high-level impact and expected monthly cost savings.
perf-bot: regression-scan complete — clean in last 30m. :white_check_mark:
jon: thanks all. Will post 90m checkpoint here with per-tenant deltas. :party:
